One deck for each part of the [course notes](https://jbrodovsky.github.io/advanced_navigation/).
The slides carry the talking points and the pictures; the notes carry the
derivations, the code, and the details. Each deck is also available as a PDF
with every slide fully revealed, for taking notes on or reviewing later.

## Presenting

Press **F** for full screen, **S** for the speaker view (notes and a timer),
**M** for the slide menu, **O** for an overview of every slide, **B** to draw on
a blackboard, **C** to draw on the slide, and **?** for the full list of keys.
The address bar keeps the current slide, so a link can open a deck at any slide.
